data.one_liner: A Flutter UI kit providing glow‑styled widgets like buttons, icons, text and switches.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a collection of pre‑built widgets with a neon‑like glow effect. It also includes a GlowTheme for app‑wide styling.
use_when: You want a consistent glow aesthetic across multiple widgets
You need ready‑made glowing buttons, icons, text, checkboxes, radios or switches
You prefer a themable solution without writing custom shaders
avoid_when: Performance‑critical apps where extra glow rendering may be costly
You need non‑glow standard Material widgets only
strengths: Easy to drop‑in replace standard widgets
Supports all Flutter platforms including web
weaknesses: No advanced customization beyond provided properties

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of Material‑styled widgets without the glow effect, useful if you don't need the neon look
